_comment: Bubblewrap TWA configuration — prepared, NOT yet buildable.
Every value here mirrors the per-locale web manifest served by
web app cannot drift apart. See docs/pwa-play-store.md.
1. Deploy the PWA work — /en/manifest.webmanifest and /icons/* currently 404
on the host below, so `bubblewrap init --manifest` has nothing to read.
2. Replace signingKey + the assetlinks fingerprint with real values.
HOST IS A TESTING ORIGIN. Building a TWA against a *.vercel.app default and moving
to a custom domain later means: move assetlinks.json, regenerate, re-review on Play,
and every existing install still pointing at the old origin.
name: Skill India Connect
_comment_startUrl: The web manifest is PER LOCALE with start_url /{locale}. A TWA is built from one of them, so the wrapper pins one launch locale. /en is the fallback locale; users switch language in-app on first run.
_comment_colors: From apps/web/src/styles/tokens.css — --color-primary-700 (brand anchor) and --background. Must match the web manifest or the splash flashes a different colour than the app.
_comment_signing: Play App Signing is the decision (docs/pwa-play-store.md B2). This keystore is the UPLOAD key only — Google holds the app signing key and re-signs. The fingerprint that goes into assetlinks.json comes from Play Console → Setup → App Integrity → App signing key certificate → SHA-256, NOT from this keystore.
_comment_notifications: Deliberately false. Push is explicitly out of scope — if it is added later it goes behind the existing notification-channel seam as a `push` tier, the way email and WhatsApp did.
_comment_fallback: If Asset Links verification fails, Chrome Custom Tabs is a less-bad fallback than a full browser window — but it still shows a URL bar. It is a safety net, not a fix.
